recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit as-is for core FHIR. If future DeviceUsage model cleanup is needed, reconcile it against the OO Incubator IG rather than editing inactive core source/deviceusage files unless DeviceUsage is reactivated in core fhir.ini.
issue_request: FHIR-20913 was a Published OO change request asking for DeviceUseStatement to represent cases such as a patient not using or not having a hearing or visual aid. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution added usageStatus 0..1 CodeableConcept and usageReason 0..* CodeableConcept rather than overloading the statement lifecycle status.
initial_application: Commit ce5720447c585c3f5d7ee73969f88fffb78a3ae1 explicitly named FHIR-20913 and added DeviceUseStatement.usageStatus and DeviceUseStatement.usageReason to the spreadsheet. Later source refactoring and the DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage rename carried those elements into source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-26308 later accepted the broader pre-applied DeviceUsage changes that included FHIR-20913. FHIR-25798 declined adding usageStatus/usageReason to the global Event pattern. FHIR-32829 later added a related DeviceUsage.adherence backbone and is already audited on the combined branch. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed DeviceUsage from active core build metadata and redirected current core links to the OO Incubator IG.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The retained source/deviceusage files still contain the FHIR-20913 elements, but source/fhir.ini no longer builds DeviceUsage as a current core resource, and the live DeviceUsage artifact is in the OO Incubator path.

related_jiras.note: Accepted pre-applied DeviceUsage changes, explicitly including the FHIR-20913 usageStatus and usageReason additions.
